CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[BulkInsertCustomers]
    @CustomerTable CustomerType READONLY, -- Suponiendo que existe un tipo de tabla definido
    @MergeStatus INT OUTPUT -- Variable de salida
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @RowCount INT = 0;

    -- Paso 1: Insertar los datos desde la tabla temporal al destino
    INSERT INTO Temp_Customer
    (
        [No_], [Name], [Address], [City], [Phone No_], [Customer Disc_ Group],
        [Country_Region Code], [Blocked], [VAT Registration No_], [Post Code],
        [County], [E-Mail], [Usual Billing Type], [Status], [Customer PROM Group],
        [Update Type], [DateUpdate], [bcid], [DateofBirth]
    )
    SELECT 
        [No_], [Name], [Address], [City], [Phone No_], [Customer Disc_ Group],
        [Country_Region Code], [Blocked], [VAT Registration No_], [Post Code],
        [County], [E-Mail], [Usual Billing Type], [Status], [Customer PROM Group],
        [Update Type], [DateUpdate], [bcid], [DateofBirth]
    FROM @CustomerTable;

    -- Paso 2: Ejecutar el MERGE para insertar o actualizar registros en la tabla de destino
    MERGE Customer AS Target
    USING Temp_Customer AS Source
    ON Target.[No_] = Source.[No_]
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET
            Target.[Name] = Source.[Name],
            Target.[Address] = Source.[Address],
            Target.[City] = Source.[City],
            Target.[Phone No_] = Source.[Phone No_],
            Target.[Customer Disc_ Group] = Source.[Customer Disc_ Group],
            Target.[Country_Region Code] = Source.[Country_Region Code],
            Target.[Blocked] = Source.[Blocked],
            Target.[VAT Registration No_] = Source.[VAT Registration No_],
            Target.[Post Code] = Source.[Post Code],
            Target.[County] = Source.[County],
            Target.[E-Mail] = Source.[E-Mail],
            Target.[Usual Billing Type] = Source.[Usual Billing Type],
            Target.[Status] = Source.[Status],
            Target.[Customer PROM Group] = Source.[Customer PROM Group],
            Target.[Update Type] = Source.[Update Type],
            Target.[DateUpdate] = Source.[DateUpdate],
            Target.[bcid] = Source.[bcid],
            Target.[DateofBirth] = Source.[DateofBirth]
    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
        INSERT (
            [No_], [Name], [Address], [City], [Phone No_], [Customer Disc_ Group],
            [Country_Region Code], [Blocked], [VAT Registration No_], [Post Code],
            [County], [E-Mail], [Usual Billing Type], [Status], [Customer PROM Group],
            [Update Type], [DateUpdate], [bcid], [DateofBirth]
        )
        VALUES (
            Source.[No_], Source.[Name], Source.[Address], Source.[City], Source.[Phone No_], Source.[Customer Disc_ Group],
            Source.[Country_Region Code], Source.[Blocked], Source.[VAT Registration No_], Source.[Post Code],
            Source.[County], Source.[E-Mail], Source.[Usual Billing Type], Source.[Status], Source.[Customer PROM Group],
            Source.[Update Type], Source.[DateUpdate], Source.[bcid], Source.[DateofBirth]
        )

		   WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE
      AND Target.[Usual Billing Type] = 0 
    THEN
      DELETE;
    -- Paso 3: Establecer la variable de estado con el número de filas afectadas
    SET @MergeStatus = @@ROWCOUNT; -- Retorna la cantidad de filas afectadas en el MERGE
END;

        [Labels UoM Code], [Gen_ Pump Ledg_ Entry], [Item Disc_ Group], [POS Price Change Allowed],

    WHEN MATCHED THEN

            Target.[Unit Price] = Source.[Unit Price],

            Target.Picture = Source.Picture,
            Target.[VAT Prod_ Posting Group] = Source.[VAT Prod_ Posting Group],

            Target.[Product Group Code] = Source.[Product Group Code],

            Target.[Labels UoM Code] = Source.[Labels UoM Code],
            Target.[Gen_ Pump Ledg_ Entry] = Source.[Gen_ Pump Ledg_ Entry],
            Target.[Item Disc_ Group] = Source.[Item Disc_ Group],
            Target.[POS Price Change Allowed] = Source.[POS Price Change Allowed],
            Target.[PROM Item Category Code] = Source.[PROM Item Category Code],
            Target.[POS Negative Quantity Allowed] = Source.[POS Negative Quantity Allowed],
            Target.BC_ID = Source.BC_ID,
            Target.VendorId = Source.VendorId,
            Target.IsAgeDiscountApplied = Source.IsAgeDiscountApplied
    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
        INSERT (
            No_, Description, [Unit Price], Blocked, Picture, [VAT Prod_ Posting Group],
            [Item Category Code], [Product Group Code], Bonified, [UoM Conversion Factor],
            [Labels UoM Code], [Gen_ Pump Ledg_ Entry], [Item Disc_ Group], [POS Price Change Allowed],
            [PROM Item Category Code], [POS Negative Quantity Allowed], BC_ID, VendorId, IsAgeDiscountApplied

            Source.No_, Source.Description, Source.[Unit Price], Source.Blocked, Source.Picture, Source.[VAT Prod_ Posting Group],

            Source.[PROM Item Category Code], Source.[POS Negative Quantity Allowed], Source.BC_ID, Source.VendorId, Source.IsAgeDiscountApplied

    DELETE FROM Item
    WHERE No_ NOT IN (SELECT No_ FROM Temp_Item);

    -- Paso 4: Establecer la variable de estado con el número de filas afectadas

END;

-- Procedimiento almacenado para realizar un Bulk Insert, MERGE y DELETE
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[BulkInsertSalesPrices]
    @SalesPriceTable SalesPriceType READONLY, -- Tabla de tipo definido en SQL
    @MergeStatus INT OUTPUT -- Variable de salida para filas afectadas
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Paso 1: Insertar los datos en la tabla temporal
    INSERT INTO Temp_SalesPrice
    (
        [Item No_], [Gas Station Code], [Starting Date], [Starting Time], [Minimum Quantity], 
        [Unit Price], [Ending Date], [Ending Time], [Status], [Id]
    )
    SELECT 
        [Item No_], [Gas Station Code], [Starting Date], [Starting Time], [Minimum Quantity], 
        [Unit Price], [Ending Date], [Ending Time], [Status], [Id]
    FROM @SalesPriceTable;

    -- Paso 2: Ejecutar el MERGE para sincronizar con la tabla de destino
    MERGE INTO [Sales Price] AS Target
    USING Temp_SalesPrice AS Source
    ON Target.[Id] = Source.[Id] -- Usar el campo `Id` como identificador único
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET
            Target.[Item No_] = Source.[Item No_],
            Target.[Gas Station Code] = Source.[Gas Station Code],
            Target.[Starting Date] = Source.[Starting Date],
            Target.[Starting Time] = Source.[Starting Time],
            Target.[Minimum Quantity] = Source.[Minimum Quantity],
            Target.[Unit Price] = Source.[Unit Price],
            Target.[Ending Date] = Source.[Ending Date],
            Target.[Ending Time] = Source.[Ending Time],
            Target.[Status] = Source.[Status]
    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
        INSERT (
            [Item No_], [Gas Station Code], [Starting Date], [Starting Time], [Minimum Quantity], 
            [Unit Price], [Ending Date], [Ending Time], [Status], [Id]
        )
        VALUES (
            Source.[Item No_], Source.[Gas Station Code], Source.[Starting Date], Source.[Starting Time], 
            Source.[Minimum Quantity], Source.[Unit Price], Source.[Ending Date], Source.[Ending Time], 
            Source.[Status], Source.[Id]
        );

    -- Paso 3: Eliminar los registros de [Sales Price] que no estén en Temp_SalesPrice
    DELETE FROM [Sales Price]
    WHERE [Id] NOT IN (SELECT [Id] FROM Temp_SalesPrice);

    -- Paso 4: Establecer la variable de salida con las filas afectadas
    SET @MergeStatus = @@ROWCOUNT;

    SET NOCOUNT OFF;
END;

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Extraer_BCPOS_Documentos]
	@nSucursal int,
	@fechaIni date,
	@fechaFin date,
	@horaSep time(1)
AS
BEGIN
		WITH CTE_turnos_transaccion AS
	(
		SELECT 
			  CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(date, [Shift Starting])) AS fecha,
			  [POS Transaction ID] AS turno_conciliador
		FROM [TPV].[dbo].[vw_POS_Closed_Shift]
		WHERE 
			CONVERT(date, [Shift Starting]) >= @fechaIni
			AND CONVERT(date, [Shift Starting]) <= @fechaFin
		GROUP BY 
			[Shift Starting], 
			[POS Transaction ID]
	),

	CTE_turnos_enumerados AS 
	(
		SELECT 
			t.fecha,
			t.turno_conciliador,
			ROW_NUMBER() OVER 
			(
				PARTITION BY t.fecha 
				ORDER BY t.turno_conciliador
			) AS indice 
		FROM CTE_turnos_transaccion t
	),
	CTE_turnos_platino AS
	(
		SELECT 
			te.fecha,
			te.turno_conciliador,
			zt.[Shift Ending] AS momento_cierre,
			CASE 
				WHEN (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM Turno WHERE codSistema = 'B') = 1 THEN 'U'
				ELSE
					CASE 
						WHEN indice = 1 THEN 'A'
						WHEN zt.[Shift Ending] <= (CONVERT(DATETIME2,
													CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), te.fecha, 120)
													+ ' '
													+ CONVERT(VARCHAR(15), @horaSep, 108)
												)) THEN 'A'
						ELSE 'B'
					END
			END AS turno
		FROM TPV.dbo.[vw_POS_Closed_Shift] zt
		INNER JOIN CTE_turnos_enumerados te
			ON zt.[POS Transaction ID] = te.turno_conciliador
		WHERE 
			 (CONVERT(date, [Shift Ending]) >= @fechaIni OR [Shift Ending] IS NULL)
			AND CONVERT(date,[Shift Starting]) <= @fechaFin
	),
	CTE_Operacion_Detalle AS
	(
SELECT 
CONVERT(date, vwTurnos.[Shift Starting]) as fecha
,vwTurnos.turno_conciliador
, isnull(CEILING(PSL.[Pump No_]/2), 
					case 
						when (select TOP 1 ubicaciones from [SC].[dbo].[Turno] where codSistema = 'B') = 1 then 1
						else -1 end
					) [bomba]
,vwTurnos.EmployeeName as usuario

,CASE 
				WHEN PSH.[POS Sales Doc_ Type] = 3 THEN 'NC'
				WHEN PSH.[POS Sales Doc_ Type] = 7 THEN 'TICKET'
				WHEN PSH.[POS Sales Doc_ Type] = 2 THEN 'FAC_CREDIT'
				WHEN PSH.[POS Sales Doc_ Type] = 1 THEN 'FACTURA'
			END AS tipo_comprobante,
			PSH.[POS Sales Doc_ No_] AS nro_comprobante,
			CONVERT(varchar(8), PSL.[Operation Time], 108) AS hora,
			ISNULL(PSH.[Cust_ Name], '') AS nombreCliente,
			ISNULL(PSH.[VAT Reg_ No_], '') AS rtnCliente,
			SUM(PSL.[Amount Including VAT]) AS facturado,
			SUM(PSL.[Line Discount Amount]) AS descuento

FROM [TPV].[dbo].[vw_POS_Log_Con_Turnos] as vwTurnos
left join [TPV].[dbo].[vw_POS_Sales_Line] PSL ON vwTurnos.[pos_transaction_id]= PSL.[POS Transaction ID] 
left join [TPV].[dbo].[vw_POS_Sales_Header] PSH ON  vwTurnos.[pos_transaction_id]= PSH.[POS Transaction ID] 
WHERE 
			CONVERT(date , vwTurnos.[Shift Starting]) >= @fechaIni 
			AND CONVERT(date , vwTurnos.[Shift Ending]) <= @fechaFin
			AND vwTurnos.[Transaction Type] <> '4'
		GROUP BY 
			vwTurnos.[Shift Starting], 
			vwTurnos.turno_conciliador,
			PSH.[POS Transaction ID], 
			CEILING(PSL.[Pump No_] / 2), 
			vwTurnos.EmployeeName,
			PSH.[POS Sales Doc_ No_], 
			PSH.[POS Sales Doc_ Type], 
			PSL.[Operation Time],
			PSH.[Cust_ Name], 
			PSH.[VAT Reg_ No_]
	)
	SELECT
		CONVERT(varchar, @nSucursal) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar, tp.fecha, 112) + 'B-' + tp.turno AS idCierre,
		@nSucursal AS nSucursal,
		'B' AS codSistema,
		od.fecha,
		tp.turno,
		od.turno_conciliador AS corteZ,
		tp.momento_cierre AS momentoCorteZ,
		od.bomba AS ubicacion,
		-1 AS corteX,
		tp.momento_cierre AS momentoCorteX,
		od.usuario,
		CASE 
			WHEN od.tipo_comprobante IN ('FACTURA', 'FACTURAT') THEN 'CONTADO'
			WHEN od.tipo_comprobante IN ('FAC_CREDIT', 'FAC_CREDTT') AND od.rtnCliente IN ('08019008199286') THEN 'CONSUMO'
			WHEN od.tipo_comprobante IN ('FAC_CREDIT', 'FAC_CREDTT') THEN 'CREDITO'
			WHEN od.tipo_comprobante IN ('NC', 'NC_T') THEN 'NOTA_CREDITO'
			ELSE 'OTRO'
		END AS tipoDocumento,
		od.nro_comprobante AS noComprobante,
		od.hora,
		od.rtnCliente,
		od.nombreCliente,
		od.facturado,
		od.descuento,
		(od.facturado + od.descuento) AS montoTotal
	FROM CTE_turnos_platino tp
	INNER JOIN CTE_Operacion_Detalle od
		ON tp.fecha = od.fecha 
		AND tp.turno_conciliador = od.turno_conciliador
	ORDER BY 
		tp.turno_conciliador ASC, 
		tp.fecha ASC, 
		od.bomba ASC
END

	),

    CTE_Lecturas_Turno AS (
        SELECT 
            vt.turno_conciliador,
            v.bomba,
            v.producto,
            v.codigo,
            vt.[Pump No_] AS surtidor,
            vt.[manguera_numero] AS manguera,

        INNER JOIN CTE_turnos_platino tp

        lt.precioUnitario,
        lt.unidad,
        lt.volumen,
        lt.monto

    FROM CTE_Lecturas_Turno lt
    INNER JOIN CTE_turnos_platino tp
        ON tp.turno_conciliador = lt.turno_conciliador
    ORDER BY 
        tp.fecha ASC,
        tp.turno ASC,
        lt.bomba ASC,
        lt.surtidor ASC;

END

, isnull(CEILING(PSL.[Pump No_]/2), 
					case 
						when (select TOP 1 ubicaciones from [SC].[dbo].[Turno] where codSistema = 'B') = 1 then 1
						else -1 end
					) [bomba]
,vwTurnos.EmployeeName as usuario

            ,SUM(PSL.[Amount Including VAT]) AS facturado,
            SUM(PSL.[Line Discount Amount]) AS descuento
FROM [TPV].[dbo].[vw_POS_Log_Con_Turnos] as vwTurnos
left join [TPV].[dbo].[vw_POS_Sales_Line] PSL ON vwTurnos.[pos_transaction_id]= PSL.[POS Transaction ID] 
left join [TPV].[dbo].[vw_POS_Sales_Header] PSH ON  vwTurnos.[pos_transaction_id]= PSH.[POS Transaction ID] 
WHERE 
			CONVERT(date , vwTurnos.[Shift Starting]) >= @fechaIni 
			AND CONVERT(date , vwTurnos.[Shift Ending]) <= @fechaFin
			AND vwTurnos.[Transaction Type] <> '4'
        GROUP BY 
vwTurnos.[Shift Starting], 
			vwTurnos.turno_conciliador,
			CEILING(PSL.[Pump No_] / 2), 
			vwTurnos.EmployeeName
    )

    SELECT
        CONVERT(VARCHAR, @nSucursal) + '-' +
        CONVERT(VARCHAR, tp.fecha, 112) +
        'B-' + tp.turno AS idCierre,
        
        @nSucursal AS nSucursal,
        'B' AS codSistema,
        vg.fecha,
        tp.turno,
        vg.turno_conciliador AS corteZ,
        tp.momento_cierre AS momentoCorteZ,
        vg.bomba AS ubicacion,
        -1 AS corteX,
        tp.momento_cierre AS momentoCorteX,
        (SELECT tasaCambio FROM sistema WHERE codSistema = 'B') AS tasaCambio,
        vg.usuario,
        vg.facturado,
        vg.descuento,
        (vg.facturado + vg.descuento) AS montoTotal

    FROM CTE_turnos_platino tp
    INNER JOIN CTE_ventas_agrupadas vg
        ON tp.fecha = vg.fecha
       AND tp.turno_conciliador = vg.turno_conciliador

    ORDER BY 
        tp.turno_conciliador ASC,
        tp.fecha ASC,
        vg.bomba ASC;

END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[Extraer_Fusion_Operaciones]
    @nSucursal INT,
    @fechaIni DATE,
    @fechaFin DATE,
    @horaSep TIME(1)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    WITH CTE_turnos_vox AS (
        SELECT fecha, id_turno
        FROM ETL_Vox
        WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fechaIni AND @fechaFin
        GROUP BY fecha, id_turno
    ),
    CTE_turnos_vox_enumerados AS (
        SELECT x.fecha, x.id_turno,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.fecha ORDER BY x.id_turno) AS indice 
        FROM CTE_turnos_vox x
    ),
    CTE_turnos_transaccion AS (
        SELECT CAST([Shift Starting] AS DATE) AS fecha, [POS Transaction ID] AS turno_conciliador
        FROM TPV.dbo.[vw_POS_Closed_Shift]
        WHERE CAST([Shift Starting] AS DATE) BETWEEN @fechaIni AND @fechaFin
        GROUP BY CAST([Shift Starting] AS DATE), [POS Transaction ID]
    ),
    CTE_turnos_transaccion_enumerados AS (
        SELECT t.fecha, t.turno_conciliador,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.fecha ORDER BY t.turno_conciliador) AS indice 
        FROM CTE_turnos_transaccion t
    ),
    CTE_turnos_union AS (
        SELECT v.fecha, t.turno_conciliador, v.id_turno, v.indice
        FROM CTE_turnos_vox_enumerados v
        INNER JOIN CTE_turnos_transaccion_enumerados t ON v.fecha = t.fecha AND v.indice = t.indice
    ),
    CTE_turnos_platino AS (
        SELECT 
            te.fecha, te.turno_conciliador, te.id_turno,
            zt.[Shift Ending] AS momento_cierre,
            CASE 
                WHEN (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM Turno WHERE codSistema = 'B') = 1 THEN 'U'
                ELSE
                    CASE 
                        WHEN te.indice = 1 THEN 'A'
                        WHEN zt.[Shift Ending] <= CAST(CONCAT(CONVERT(varchar(10), te.fecha, 120),' ',@horaSep) AS datetime) THEN 'A'
                        ELSE 'B'
                    END
            END AS turno
        FROM TPV.dbo.[vw_POS_Closed_Shift] zt
        INNER JOIN CTE_turnos_union te ON zt.[POS Transaction ID] = te.turno_conciliador
    ),

    CTE_Lecturas_Detalle AS (
        SELECT 
            id_turno, surtidor, manguera, precio_unit, volumen_inicial, volumen_final,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id_turno, surtidor, manguera ORDER BY volumen_inicial ASC) as transaccion_asc,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id_turno, surtidor, manguera ORDER BY volumen_inicial DESC) as transaccion_desc
        FROM ETL_Vox
        WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fechaIni AND @fechaFin
    ),

    CTE_Lecturas_Agrupadas AS (
        SELECT 
            id_turno, surtidor, manguera,
            MAX(precio_unit) AS precioUnitario,
            MAX(CASE WHEN transaccion_asc = 1 THEN volumen_inicial END) AS valInicial,
            MAX(CASE WHEN transaccion_desc = 1 THEN volumen_final END) AS valFinal
        FROM CTE_Lecturas_Detalle
        GROUP BY id_turno, surtidor, manguera
    ),

    TurnosConjunto AS (
        SELECT
            tp.fecha, tp.turno, tp.momento_cierre, tp.turno_conciliador, tp.id_turno,
            v.bomba, v.producto, v.codigo, v.surtidor, v.manguera, v.unidad
        FROM CTE_turnos_platino tp
        CROSS JOIN [SC].[dbo].[vw_info_bomba] v
    )

    SELECT 
        CONVERT(VARCHAR, @nSucursal) + '-' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, tc.fecha, 112) + 'B-' + tc.turno AS [idCierre],
        @nSucursal AS [nSucursal],
        'B' AS [codSistema],
        tc.fecha,
        tc.turno,
        tc.turno_conciliador AS [corteZ],
        tc.momento_cierre AS [momentoCorteZ],
        tc.bomba AS [ubicacion],
        tc.producto,
        tc.codigo,
        'Lectura' AS [tipoRegistro],
        'BSM:' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, (tc.bomba * 100 + tc.surtidor * 10 + tc.manguera)) AS [infoExtra],
        ISNULL(la.precioUnitario, 0) AS precioUnitario,
        tc.unidad,
        ISNULL(la.valInicial, 0) AS valInicial,
        ISNULL(la.valFinal, 0) AS valFinal
    FROM TurnosConjunto tc
    LEFT JOIN CTE_Lecturas_Agrupadas la 
        ON tc.id_turno COLLATE Modern_Spanish_100_CI_AS = la.id_turno COLLATE Modern_Spanish_100_CI_AS
        AND tc.surtidor = la.surtidor
        AND tc.manguera = la.manguera
    ORDER BY tc.fecha ASC, tc.turno ASC, tc.bomba ASC, tc.surtidor DESC;

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetCustomer]
    @Paramtro VARCHAR(100),
    @type VARCHAR(50)   -- valores posibles: '0', '1', '0,1'
AS
BEGIN

    SELECT TOP (100)
        [No_],
        [Name], 
        [Address], 
        [City], 
        [Phone No_], 
        [Country_Region Code],
        [Blocked], 
        [VAT Registration No_], 
        [Post Code], 
        [County],
        [E-Mail], 
        [Usual Billing Type], 
        [bcid], 
        DateofBirth,

        CASE 
            WHEN DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, DateofBirth, GETDATE()), DateofBirth) > GETDATE() 
            THEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, DateofBirth, GETDATE()) - 1
            ELSE DATEDIFF(YEAR, DateofBirth, GETDATE())
        END AS Age,

        CASE
            WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, DateofBirth, GETDATE()) BETWEEN 65 AND 79 THEN 25
            WHEN DATEDIFF(YEAR, DateofBirth, GETDATE()) >= 80 THEN 35
            ELSE 0
        END AS AgeDiscountPercentage

    FROM [Customer]
    WHERE 
        [Blocked] = 0
        AND ([Usual Billing Type] IN (
                SELECT CAST(Item AS INT) 
                FROM dbo.fn_Split(@type, ',')
            ))
        AND (
            [Name] LIKE '%' + @Paramtro + '%'
            OR [VAT Registration No_] LIKE '%' + @Paramtro + '%'
        )
    ORDER BY DateUpdate DESC;

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetDetailbyfuels]
    @FechaTurno DATE,
    @Turno INT,
    @StoreID VARCHAR(5),
    @PosNumber VARCHAR(5)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @Columnas NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);

    -- Obtener los nombres de las columnas dinámicas basadas en [POS Sales No_]
    SELECT @Columnas = STRING_AGG(
        CONCAT(
            'SUM(CASE WHEN [POS Sales No_] = ''', [POS Sales No_], ''' THEN [Quantity] ELSE 0 END) AS [Volumen ', [POS Sales No_], '], ',
            'SUM(CASE WHEN [POS Sales No_] = ''', [POS Sales No_], ''' THEN [Amount Including VAT] ELSE 0 END) AS [Monto ', [POS Sales No_], ']'
        ),
        ', '
    )
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT [POS Sales No_] 
          FROM [POS Sales Line] PSL
          LEFT JOIN [POS Transaction Log] PTL ON PSL.[POS Transaction ID] = PTL.[POS Transaction ID]
          WHERE PTL.[Shift Date] = @FechaTurno
            AND PTL.[Shift No_] = @Turno
            AND PSL.[Gas Station Code] = @StoreID
            AND PSL.[POS Code] = @PosNumber
            AND [Pump No_] <> ''
    ) AS Productos;

    -- Construir la consulta dinámica
    SET @SQL = '
    SELECT 
        [Pump No_] AS Bomba,
        SUM([Quantity]) AS [Total Cantidad],
        ' + @Columnas + '
    FROM [POS Sales Line] PSL
    LEFT JOIN [POS Transaction Log] PTL ON PSL.[POS Transaction ID] = PTL.[POS Transaction ID]
    WHERE PTL.[Shift Date] = @FechaTurno
      AND PTL.[Shift No_] = @Turno
      AND PSL.[Gas Station Code] = @StoreID
      AND PSL.[POS Code] = @PosNumber
      AND [Pump No_] <> ''''
    GROUP BY [Pump No_]
    ORDER BY [Pump No_];
    ';

    -- Ejecutar la consulta dinámica
    EXEC sp_executesql @SQL, 
                       N'@FechaTurno DATE, @Turno INT, @StoreID VARCHAR(5), @PosNumber VARCHAR(5)', 
                       @FechaTurno, @Turno, @StoreID, @PosNumber;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetDetailsDesgloseforAdministrator]
    @TURNO INT = 1,
    @Fechaturno DATE = NULL,
    @StoreID NVARCHAR(10),
    @PosCode NVARCHAR(5) = '0'
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Manejo de fecha por defecto (fecha actual si no se proporciona)
    IF @Fechaturno IS NULL
        SET @Fechaturno = GETDATE();

    DECLARE @ISV15 DECIMAL(18,2);
    DECLARE @ISV18 DECIMAL(18,2);
    DECLARE @TotalFinal DECIMAL(18,2);

    -- Asignación de @ISV15
    SET @ISV15 = (
        SELECT 
            ISNULL(CAST(SUM([VAT_Amount]) AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 0)
        FROM 
            [POS Sales Line] PSCL
        LEFT JOIN 
            [POS Transaction Log] PTL 
            ON PSCL.[POS Transaction ID] = PTL.[POS Transaction ID]
        WHERE 
            [VAT Prod_ Posting Group] = 'ISV_15'
            AND (@TURNO = 0 OR PTL.[Shift No_] = @TURNO)
            AND PTL.[Shift Date] = @Fechaturno
            AND PTL.[Gas Station Code] = @StoreID
            AND (@PosCode = '0' OR PTL.[POS Code] = @PosCode)
    );

    -- Asignación de @ISV18
    SET @ISV18 = (
        SELECT 
            ISNULL(CAST(SUM([VAT_Amount]) AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 0)
        FROM 
            [POS Sales Line] PSCL
        LEFT JOIN 
            [POS Transaction Log] PTL 
            ON PSCL.[POS Transaction ID] = PTL.[POS Transaction ID]
        WHERE 
            [VAT Prod_ Posting Group] = 'ISV_18'
            AND (@TURNO = 0 OR PTL.[Shift No_] = @TURNO)
            AND PTL.[Shift Date] = @Fechaturno
            AND PTL.[Gas Station Code] = @StoreID
            AND (@PosCode = '0' OR PTL.[POS Code] = @PosCode)
    );

    -- Asignación de @TotalFinal
    SET @TotalFinal = (
        SELECT 
            ISNULL(CAST(SUM([Amount Including VAT]) AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 0) AS Total
        FROM 
            [POS Sales Line] PSCL
        LEFT JOIN 
            [POS Transaction Log] PTL 
            ON PSCL.[POS Transaction ID] = PTL.[POS Transaction ID]
        WHERE 
            (@TURNO = 0 OR PTL.[Shift No_] = @TURNO)
            AND PTL.[Shift Date] = @Fechaturno
            AND PTL.[Gas Station Code] = @StoreID
            AND (@PosCode = '0' OR PTL.[POS Code] = @PosCode)
    );

    -- Consulta consolidada
    SELECT Tipo, Total
    FROM (
        -- Exento
        SELECT 
            'Exento' AS Tipo, 
            ISNULL(CAST(SUM([Amount Including VAT]) AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 0) AS Total,
            1 AS Orden
        FROM 
            [POS Sales Line] PSCL
        LEFT JOIN 
            [POS Transaction Log] PTL 
            ON PSCL.[POS Transaction ID] = PTL.[POS Transaction ID]
        WHERE 
            [VAT Prod_ Posting Group] = 'EXENTO'
            AND (@TURNO = 0 OR PTL.[Shift No_] = @TURNO)
            AND PTL.[Shift Date] = @Fechaturno
            AND PTL.[Gas Station Code] = @StoreID
            AND (@PosCode = '0' OR PTL.[POS Code] = @PosCode)

        UNION ALL

        -- Gravado 15%
        SELECT 
            'Gravado 15%' AS Tipo, 
		ISNULL(CAST(SUM([Amount Including VAT]) / (1 + 0.15) AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 0) AS Total, 
            2 AS Orden
        FROM 
            [POS Sales Line] PSCL
        LEFT JOIN 
            [POS Transaction Log] PTL 
            ON PSCL.[POS Transaction ID] = PTL.[POS Transaction ID]
        WHERE 
            [VAT Prod_ Posting Group] = 'ISV_15'
            AND (@TURNO = 0 OR PTL.[Shift No_] = @TURNO)
            AND PTL.[Shift Date] = @Fechaturno
            AND PTL.[Gas Station Code] = @StoreID
            AND (@PosCode = '0' OR PTL.[POS Code] = @PosCode)

        UNION ALL

        -- Gravado 18%
        SELECT 
            'Gravado 18%' AS Tipo, 
		ISNULL(CAST(SUM([Amount Including VAT]) / (1 + 0.18) AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 0) AS Total, 
            3 AS Orden
        FROM 
            [POS Sales Line] PSCL
        LEFT JOIN 
            [POS Transaction Log] PTL 
            ON PSCL.[POS Transaction ID] = PTL.[POS Transaction ID]
        WHERE 
            [VAT Prod_ Posting Group] = 'ISV_18'
            AND (@TURNO = 0 OR PTL.[Shift No_] = @TURNO)
            AND PTL.[Shift Date] = @Fechaturno
            AND PTL.[Gas Station Code] = @StoreID
            AND (@PosCode = '0' OR PTL.[POS Code] = @PosCode)

        UNION ALL

        -- Subtotal
        SELECT 
            'Subtotal' AS Tipo, 
            @TotalFinal - (@ISV15 + @ISV18) AS Total,
            4 AS Orden

        UNION ALL

        -- ISV_15
        SELECT 
            'ISV_15' AS Tipo, 
            @ISV15 AS Total,
            5 AS Orden

        UNION ALL

        -- ISV_18
        SELECT 
            'ISV_18' AS Tipo, 
            @ISV18 AS Total,
            6 AS Orden

        UNION ALL

        -- Total Impuestos
        SELECT 
            'Total Impuestos' AS Tipo, 
            ISNULL(CAST(SUM([VAT_Amount]) AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 0) AS Total,
            7 AS Orden
        FROM 
            [POS Sales Line] PSCL
        LEFT JOIN 
            [POS Transaction Log] PTL 
            ON PSCL.[POS Transaction ID] = PTL.[POS Transaction ID]
        WHERE 
            [VAT Prod_ Posting Group] <> 'EXENTO'
            AND (@TURNO = 0 OR PTL.[Shift No_] = @TURNO)
            AND PTL.[Shift Date] = @Fechaturno
            AND PTL.[Gas Station Code] = @StoreID
            AND (@PosCode = '0' OR PTL.[POS Code] = @PosCode)

        UNION ALL

        -- Total Final
        SELECT 
            'Total Final' AS Tipo, 
            @TotalFinal AS Total,
            8 AS Orden
    ) AS Resultado
    ORDER BY Orden;
END;

-- Procedimiento almacenado para obtener la factura inicial y final
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetDetailsMaxAndMinInvoiceforAdministrator]
    @TURNO INT,
    @Fechaturno DATE,
    @StoreID NVARCHAR(10),
    @PosCode NVARCHAR(5) = '0' -- Valor por defecto
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- CTE para ordenar las ventas
    WITH OrderedSales AS (
        SELECT 
            PSH.[POS Sales Doc_ No_],
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY PSH.[Sale Date Time] ASC) AS RowAsc,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY PSH.[Sale Date Time] DESC) AS RowDesc
        FROM 
            [TPV].[dbo].[POS Sales Header] PSH
        LEFT JOIN 
            [POS Transaction Log] PTL ON PSH.[POS Transaction ID] = PTL.[POS Transaction ID]
        WHERE 
            PSH.[Gas Station Code] = @StoreID
            AND (@PosCode = '0' OR PTL.[POS Code] = @PosCode)
            AND (@TURNO = 0 OR PTL.[Shift No_] = @TURNO)
            AND PTL.[Shift Date] = @Fechaturno
    )
    
    -- Selección del primer y último documento
    SELECT 
        'FAC. INICIAL #' AS Tipo,
        [POS Sales Doc_ No_]
    FROM 
        OrderedSales
    WHERE 
        RowAsc = 1

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        'FAC. FINAL #' AS Tipo,
        [POS Sales Doc_ No_]
    FROM 
        OrderedSales
    WHERE 
        RowDesc = 1;
END;

    SET NOCOUNT ON;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetProducts]

    @StoreID NVARCHAR(10)

    SELECT top (100) I.[No_],
           SP.[Unit Price] ,

           I.[Picture],
           I.[VAT Prod_ Posting Group],
ISNULL(I.[Item Category Code], '') AS [Item Category Code], -- <--- Cambio solicitado

    ORDER BY [Starting Time] ASC;

BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    ;WITH SalesData AS (

            MIN([POS Sales Doc_ No_]) AS Desde,

            SUM(CASE WHEN [VAT Prod_ Posting Group] = 'EXENTO' THEN [Amount Including VAT] ELSE 0 END) AS Exento,

        FROM [TPV].[dbo].[POS Sales Line] PSL
        LEFT JOIN [TPV].[dbo].[POS Transaction Log] PTL

    ORDER BY Fecha;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetSalebyFuelAttendantbyChargeMethod]
    @FechaTurno DATE,
    @Turno INT,
    @StoreID VARCHAR(5),
    @PosNumber VARCHAR(5)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Obtener las formas de pago dinámicamente
    DECLARE @FormasPago NVARCHAR(MAX);

    SELECT @FormasPago = STRING_AGG(QUOTENAME([Description]), ',')
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT PSCL.[Description]
        FROM [TPV].[dbo].[POS Sales Charge Line] PSCL
        LEFT JOIN [POS Transaction Log] PTL 
            ON PSCL.[POS Transaction ID] = PTL.[POS Transaction ID]
        WHERE PTL.[Shift Date] = @FechaTurno 
              AND PTL.[Shift No_] = @Turno 
              AND PSCL.[Gas Station Code] = @StoreID 
              AND PSCL.[POS Code] = @PosNumber
    ) AS FormasPago;

    -- Generar la consulta dinámica
    DECLARE @Consulta NVARCHAR(MAX);

    SET @Consulta = '
    SELECT 
        Bombero,
        [Pump No_] AS Dispensadora,
        ' + @FormasPago + '
    FROM (
        SELECT 
              CONCAT(FA.Nombres, '' '', FA.Apellidos) AS Bombero,
              PSL.[Pump No_],
              PSCL.[Description],
              SUM(PSCL.[Amount]) AS TotalAmount
        FROM [TPV].[dbo].[POS Sales Charge Line] PSCL
        LEFT JOIN [POS Transaction Log] PTL 
            ON PSCL.[POS Transaction ID] = PTL.[POS Transaction ID]
        LEFT JOIN [POS Sales Line] PSL 
            ON PSCL.[POS Transaction ID] = PSL.[POS Transaction ID]
        LEFT JOIN FuelAttendant FA 
            ON PSL.idFuelAttendant = FA.idFuelAttendant
        WHERE PTL.[Shift Date] = ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, @FechaTurno, 120) + ''' 
		          AND PSL.[Pump No_] <> ''''

              AND PTL.[Shift No_] = ' + CAST(@Turno AS NVARCHAR) + '
              AND PSCL.[Gas Station Code] = ''' + @StoreID + ''' 
              AND PSCL.[POS Code] = ''' + @PosNumber + '''
        GROUP BY CONCAT(FA.Nombres, '' '', FA.Apellidos), PSL.[Pump No_], PSCL.[Description]
    ) AS Fuente
    PIVOT (
        SUM(TotalAmount)
        FOR [Description] IN (' + @FormasPago + ')
    ) AS Pivoteo
    ORDER BY CAST([Pump No_] AS INT) ASC;
    ';

    -- Ejecutar consulta dinámica
    EXEC sp_executesql @Consulta;
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetSaleForAccountStatement]
    @ClientRTN VARCHAR(50),
    @FechaDesde DATE,
    @FechaHasta DATE
AS
BEGIN
    SELECT 
        CASE
            WHEN H.[POS Sales Doc_ Type] = 2 THEN CONCAT('FAC ', H.[POS Sales Doc_ No_])
            WHEN H.[POS Sales Doc_ Type] = 3 THEN CONCAT('NC ', H.[POS Sales Doc_ No_])
        END AS Documento,
        H.[Orden] AS #Orden,
        H.[Placa],
        H.[Chofer],
        H.[KM],
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), H.[Sale Date Time], 103) AS Emision,
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), H.[Sale Date Time], 108) AS Hora,
        STUFF(
            (
                SELECT ' | ' + L.[Description]
                FROM [TPV].[dbo].[POS Sales Line] L
                WHERE L.[POS Transaction ID] = H.[POS Transaction ID]
                ORDER BY L.[POS Sales Doc_ Line No_]
                FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
            ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 3, ''
        ) AS Producto,

        -- 👉 Si es devolución, Total debe ser 0
   H.[Amount] AS Total,

        '0.0' AS Descuento,
        '0.0' AS Recargo,

        -- 👉 Si es devolución, mostrar monto aquí
        CASE 
            WHEN H.[POS Sales Doc_ Type] = 3 THEN H.[Amount]
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS Devolucion,

        '0.0' AS Abono,

        -- 👉 Saldo: Facturas suman / devoluciones restan
        CASE 
            WHEN H.[POS Sales Doc_ Type] = 3 THEN (H.[Amount])
            ELSE H.[Amount]
        END AS Saldo

    FROM [TPV].[dbo].[POS Sales Header] H
    WHERE 
        CONVERT(DATE, H.[Sale Date Time]) BETWEEN @FechaDesde AND @FechaHasta
        AND H.[Customer No_] = @ClientRTN
        AND H.[Billing Type] = 0;
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetSalesByFuelAllFuelAttendantPOSSalesChargeLine]
    @GasStation NVARCHAR(10),
    @PosCode NVARCHAR(10),
    @FechaTurno DATE,
    @Turno INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @Columns NVARCHAR(MAX);
    DECLARE @SumColumns NVARCHAR(MAX);
    DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);

    -- Obtener los nombres únicos de las categorías en [Description]
    SELECT @Columns = STRING_AGG(QUOTENAME([Description]), ',') 
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT [Description]
        FROM [TPV].[dbo].[POS Sales Charge Line] PSCL
        LEFT JOIN [POS Transaction Log] PTL 
            ON PSCL.[POS Transaction ID] = PTL.[POS Transaction ID]
        WHERE 
            PSCL.[Gas Station Code] = @GasStation
            AND PSCL.[POS Code] = @PosCode
            AND PTL.[Shift Date] = @FechaTurno
            AND PTL.[Shift No_] = @Turno
    ) AS Descriptions;

    -- Construir la suma dinámica para la columna Total
    SELECT @SumColumns = STRING_AGG('COALESCE(' + QUOTENAME([Description]) + ', 0)', ' + ')
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT [Description]
        FROM [TPV].[dbo].[POS Sales Charge Line] PSCL
        LEFT JOIN [POS Transaction Log] PTL 
            ON PSCL.[POS Transaction ID] = PTL.[POS Transaction ID]
        WHERE 
            PSCL.[Gas Station Code] = @GasStation
            AND PSCL.[POS Code] = @PosCode
            AND PTL.[Shift Date] = @FechaTurno
            AND PTL.[Shift No_] = @Turno
    ) AS Descriptions;

    -- Construir la consulta dinámica
    SET @SQL = '
    WITH BaseData AS (
        SELECT 
            PSCL.[idFuelAttendant],
            Bombero = (SELECT Bombero 
                       FROM [dbo].[GetBomberoInfoTVF](@GasStation, @PosCode, @FechaTurno, @Turno, PSCL.[idFuelAttendant])),
            PSCL.[Description],
            SUM(PSCL.[Amount]) AS Monto
        FROM 
            [TPV].[dbo].[POS Sales Charge Line] PSCL
        LEFT JOIN 
            [POS Transaction Log] PTL 
            ON PSCL.[POS Transaction ID] = PTL.[POS Transaction ID]
        WHERE 
            PSCL.[Gas Station Code] = @GasStation
            AND PSCL.[POS Code] = @PosCode
            AND PTL.[Shift Date] = @FechaTurno
            AND PTL.[Shift No_] = @Turno
        GROUP BY 
            PSCL.[idFuelAttendant], 
            PSCL.[Description]
    )
    SELECT 
        idFuelAttendant,
        Bombero, ' + @Columns + ',
        (' + @SumColumns + ') AS Total
    FROM 
        BaseData
    PIVOT (
        SUM(Monto)
        FOR [Description] IN (' + @Columns + ')
    ) AS PivotTable
    ORDER BY idFuelAttendant;';

    -- Ejecutar la consulta dinámica
    EXEC sp_executesql @SQL, 
                       N'@GasStation NVARCHAR(10), @PosCode NVARCHAR(10), @FechaTurno DATE, @Turno INT',
                       @GasStation, @PosCode, @FechaTurno, @Turno;
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetTotalizerforAdministrador]
    @TURNO INT,
    @Fechaturno DATE,
    @StoreID NVARCHAR(10),
    @PosCode NVARCHAR(5)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Declarar la tabla variable para almacenar los datos intermedios
    DECLARE @TablaVariable TABLE (
        [Pump No_] NVARCHAR(20),
        [Pump Position No_] NVARCHAR(20),
        MinSaleID NVARCHAR(50),
        MaxSaleID NVARCHAR(50)
    );

    -- Insertar los valores en la tabla variable
    INSERT INTO @TablaVariable ([Pump No_], [Pump Position No_], MinSaleID, MaxSaleID)
    SELECT 
        PSL.[Pump No_], 
        PSL.[Pump Position No_],
        MIN(PSL.[SaleID]) AS MinSaleID,
        MAX(PSL.[SaleID]) AS MaxSaleID
    FROM [TPV].[dbo].[POS Sales Line] PSL
    LEFT JOIN [POS Transaction Log] PTL 
        ON PSL.[POS Transaction ID] = PTL.[POS Transaction ID]
    WHERE (@TURNO = 0 OR PTL.[Shift No_] = @TURNO)
      AND PTL.[Shift Date] = @Fechaturno
      AND PTL.[Gas Station Code] = @StoreID
      AND (@PosCode = '0' OR PTL.[POS Code] = @PosCode)
      AND [SaleID] <> ''
    GROUP BY PSL.[Pump No_], PSL.[Pump Position No_]
    ORDER BY PSL.[Pump No_], PSL.[Pump Position No_];

    -- Consultar información basada en SaleID
    SELECT 
        TV.[Pump No_],
        TV.[Pump Position No_],
        FSInicio.[InitialVolumeTotal] AS Inicio,
        FSFinal.[FinalVolumeTotal] AS Final
    FROM @TablaVariable TV
    LEFT JOIN [FusionController].[dbo].[FusionSales] FSInicio
        ON FSInicio.[SaleID] = TV.MinSaleID
    LEFT JOIN [FusionController].[dbo].[FusionSales] FSFinal
        ON FSFinal.[SaleID] = TV.MaxSaleID
    ORDER BY TV.[Pump No_], TV.[Pump Position No_];
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SaleByChangeMethodeByPump]
    @ShiftDate DATE,
    @ShiftNo INT,
    @GasStationCode NVARCHAR(10),
    @POSCode NVARCHAR(10)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @sql AS NVARCHAR(MAX);  
    DECLARE @columns AS NVARCHAR(MAX);

    -- Crear lista dinámica de columnas para las bombas con el nombre del bombero
    SELECT @columns = STRING_AGG(
        QUOTENAME(CAST([Pump No_] AS NVARCHAR) + ' (' + ISNULL([Bombero], 'Desconocido') + ')'), ', ')
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT 
            PSL.[Pump No_],
            CONCAT(FA.Nombres, ' ', FA.Apellidos) AS [Bombero]
        FROM [POS Sales Line] PSL
        LEFT JOIN [POS Sales Charge Line] PSCL 
            ON PSL.[POS Transaction ID] = PSCL.[POS Transaction ID]
        LEFT JOIN [POS Transaction Log] PTL 
            ON PSCL.[POS Transaction ID] = PTL.[POS Transaction ID]
        LEFT JOIN [TPV].[dbo].[FuelAttendant] FA
            ON PSL.idFuelAttendant = FA.idFuelAttendant
	
        WHERE 
            CONVERT(DATE, PTL.[Shift Date]) = @ShiftDate
            AND PTL.[Shift No_] = @ShiftNo
            AND PSCL.[Gas Station Code] = @GasStationCode
            AND PSCL.[POS Code] = @POSCode
			AND PSL.[Gen_ Pump Ledg_ Entry] =1
    ) AS Pumps;

    -- Generar consulta dinámica para el pivote
    SET @sql = N'
    SELECT 
        [Charge Method Code],
        [Description],  
        TotalAmount AS [Total General], -- Columna con el total general
        ' + @columns + '
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            PSCL.[Charge Method Code],
            PSCL.[Description],  
            CAST(PSL.[Pump No_] AS NVARCHAR) + '' ('' + ISNULL(CONCAT(FA.Nombres, '' '', FA.Apellidos), ''Desconocido'') + '')'' AS [Pump Info],
            SUM(PSCL.[Amount]) AS PumpTotal, -- Total por bomba
            SUM(SUM(PSCL.[Amount])) OVER (PARTITION BY PSCL.[Charge Method Code], PSCL.[Description]) AS TotalAmount -- Total general
        FROM [POS Sales Charge Line] PSCL
        LEFT JOIN [TPV].[dbo].[POS Transaction Log] PTL 
            ON PSCL.[POS Transaction ID] = PTL.[POS Transaction ID]
        LEFT JOIN [TPV].[dbo].[POS Sales Line] PSL 
            ON PSCL.[POS Transaction ID] = PSL.[POS Transaction ID]
        LEFT JOIN [TPV].[dbo].[FuelAttendant] FA
            ON PSL.idFuelAttendant = FA.idFuelAttendant
        WHERE 
            CONVERT(DATE, PTL.[Shift Date]) = ''' + CAST(@ShiftDate AS NVARCHAR) + ''' 
            AND PTL.[Shift No_] = ' + CAST(@ShiftNo AS NVARCHAR) + ' 
            AND PSCL.[Gas Station Code] = ''' + @GasStationCode + '''
			AND PSCL.[Gas Station Code] = ''' + @GasStationCode + '''
			AND PSL.[Gen_ Pump Ledg_ Entry] = 1
            AND PSCL.[POS Code] = ''' + @POSCode + '''
        GROUP BY 
            PSCL.[Charge Method Code],
            PSCL.[Description],  
            PSL.[Pump No_],
            FA.Nombres,
            FA.Apellidos
    ) AS SourceTable
    PIVOT (
        SUM(PumpTotal) 
        FOR [Pump Info] IN (' + @columns + ')
    ) AS PivotTable
    ORDER BY [Charge Method Code], [Description];';

    -- Ejecutar consulta dinámica
    EXEC sp_executesql @sql;
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetSalesOtrosProductosv2] 
    @FechaDesde DATE,

    @Turno INT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON; 

    SELECT 
        PTL.[EmployeeName],
        PTL.[Shift No_] AS Shift,
        PSL.[POS Sales No_] AS PosSalesNo,
        PSL.[Description] AS Description,

        -- Cantidades y montos para contado ([Billing Type] = 1)
        SUM(CASE WHEN PSH.[Billing Type] = 1 THEN PSL.[Quantity] ELSE 0 END) AS QuantityContado,
        SUM(CASE WHEN PSH.[Billing Type] = 1 THEN PSL.[Amount Including VAT] ELSE 0 END) AS AmountContado,

        -- Cantidades y montos para crédito ([Billing Type] = 0)
        SUM(CASE WHEN PSH.[Billing Type] = 0 THEN PSL.[Quantity] ELSE 0 END) AS QuantityCredito,
        SUM(CASE WHEN PSH.[Billing Type] = 0 THEN PSL.[Amount Including VAT] ELSE 0 END) AS AmountCredito,

        -- Totales
        SUM(PSL.[Quantity]) AS TotalQuantity,
        SUM(PSL.[Amount Including VAT]) AS TotalAmount

    FROM [TPV].[dbo].[POS Transaction Log] PTL
    INNER JOIN [TPV].[dbo].[POS Sales Line] PSL 
        ON PTL.[POS Transaction ID] = PSL.[POS Transaction ID]
    INNER JOIN [TPV].[dbo].[POS Sales Header] PSH
        ON PSL.[POS Transaction ID] = PSH.[POS Transaction ID]
    WHERE 
        CONVERT(DATE, PTL.[Shift Date]) BETWEEN @FechaDesde AND @FechaHasta
        AND PSL.[POS Sales Doc_ Type] IN ('1', '3')
        AND PSL.[POS Sales No_] NOT IN ('COM00002', 'COM00003', 'COM00001', 'GAS00001')
        AND (@Turno IS NULL OR @Turno = 0 OR PTL.[Shift No_] = @Turno)
    GROUP BY 
        PTL.[EmployeeName], 
        PTL.[Shift No_], 
        PSL.[POS Sales No_], 
        PSL.[Description]
    ORDER BY 
        PTL.[EmployeeName], 
        PTL.[Shift No_],

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetSalesSummary]
    @FechaDesde DATE,
    @FechaHasta DATE,
    @Turno INT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- CTE con filtro condicional por turno
    ;WITH SalesSummary AS (
        SELECT 
            PTL.[EmployeeName],
            PTL.[Shift No_], 
            CONVERT(DATE, PTL.[Shift Date]) as FechaTurno ,

            PSL.[POS Sales No_],
            SUM(PSL.[Quantity]) AS TotalQuantity,
            SUM(PSL.[Amount Including VAT]) AS TotalAmount
        FROM [TPV].[dbo].[POS Transaction Log] PTL
        INNER JOIN [POS Sales Line] PSL 
            ON PTL.[POS Transaction ID] = PSL.[POS Transaction ID]
        WHERE 
            CONVERT(DATE, PTL.[Shift Date]) BETWEEN @FechaDesde AND @FechaHasta
            AND PSL.[POS Sales Doc_ Type] IN ('1', '3')
            AND PSL.[POS Sales No_] IN ('COM00002', 'COM00003', 'COM00001', 'GAS00001')
            AND (@Turno IS NULL OR @Turno = 0 OR PTL.[Shift No_] = @Turno)
        GROUP BY PTL.[EmployeeName], PTL.[Shift No_], PSL.[POS Sales No_], PTL.[Shift Date]
    )

    SELECT 
        SS.EmployeeName,
        SS.[Shift No_] AS [Shift],
        SS.FechaTurno,
        ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN SS.[POS Sales No_] = 'COM00002' THEN SS.TotalQuantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SUPER_Vol,
        ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN SS.[POS Sales No_] = 'COM00002' THEN SS.TotalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS SUPER_Monto,

        ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN SS.[POS Sales No_] = 'COM00003' THEN SS.TotalQuantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS REGULAR_Vol,
        ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN SS.[POS Sales No_] = 'COM00003' THEN SS.TotalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS REGULAR_Monto,

        ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN SS.[POS Sales No_] = 'COM00001' THEN SS.TotalQuantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DIESEL_Vol,
        ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN SS.[POS Sales No_] = 'COM00001' THEN SS.TotalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DIESEL_Monto,

        ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN SS.[POS Sales No_] = 'GAS00001' THEN SS.TotalQuantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS KEROSENE_Vol,
        ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN SS.[POS Sales No_] = 'GAS00001' THEN SS.TotalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS KEROSENE_Monto,

        ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN SS.[POS Sales No_] IN ('COM00002', 'COM00003', 'COM00001', 'GAS00001') THEN SS.TotalQuantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Total_Volumen,
        ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN SS.[POS Sales No_] IN ('COM00002', 'COM00003', 'COM00001', 'GAS00001') THEN SS.TotalAmount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Total_Monto,

        -- Precios por tipo de combustible
        ISNULL((
            STUFF((SELECT DISTINCT ' | ' + CAST(CAST(PSL.[Unit Price Incl_ VAT] AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50))
                   FROM [POS Sales Line] PSL
                   INNER JOIN [TPV].[dbo].[POS Transaction Log] PTL 
                       ON PTL.[POS Transaction ID] = PSL.[POS Transaction ID]
                   WHERE PTL.EmployeeName = SS.EmployeeName 
                       AND CONVERT(DATE, PTL.[Shift Date]) BETWEEN @FechaDesde AND @FechaHasta
                       AND PTL.[Shift No_] = SS.[Shift No_]
                       AND PSL.[POS Sales No_] = 'COM00002'
                       AND (@Turno IS NULL OR @Turno = 0 OR PTL.[Shift No_] = @Turno)
                   FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 3, '')), '') AS SUPER_Precio,

        ISNULL((
            STUFF((SELECT DISTINCT ' | ' + CAST(CAST(PSL.[Unit Price Incl_ VAT] AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50))
                   FROM [POS Sales Line] PSL
                   INNER JOIN [TPV].[dbo].[POS Transaction Log] PTL 
                       ON PTL.[POS Transaction ID] = PSL.[POS Transaction ID]
                   WHERE PTL.EmployeeName = SS.EmployeeName 
                       AND CONVERT(DATE, PTL.[Shift Date]) BETWEEN @FechaDesde AND @FechaHasta
                       AND PTL.[Shift No_] = SS.[Shift No_]
                       AND PSL.[POS Sales No_] = 'COM00003'
                       AND (@Turno IS NULL OR @Turno = 0 OR PTL.[Shift No_] = @Turno)
                   FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 3, '')), '') AS REGULAR_Precio,

        ISNULL((
            STUFF((SELECT DISTINCT ' | ' + CAST(CAST(PSL.[Unit Price Incl_ VAT] AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50))
                   FROM [POS Sales Line] PSL
                   INNER JOIN [TPV].[dbo].[POS Transaction Log] PTL 
                       ON PTL.[POS Transaction ID] = PSL.[POS Transaction ID]
                   WHERE PTL.EmployeeName = SS.EmployeeName 
                       AND CONVERT(DATE, PTL.[Shift Date]) BETWEEN @FechaDesde AND @FechaHasta
                       AND PTL.[Shift No_] = SS.[Shift No_]
                       AND PSL.[POS Sales No_] = 'COM00001'
                       AND (@Turno IS NULL OR @Turno = 0 OR PTL.[Shift No_] = @Turno)
                   FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 3, '')), '') AS DIESEL_Precio,

        ISNULL((
            STUFF((SELECT DISTINCT ' | ' + CAST(CAST(PSL.[Unit Price Incl_ VAT] AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50))
                   FROM [POS Sales Line] PSL
                   INNER JOIN [TPV].[dbo].[POS Transaction Log] PTL 
                       ON PTL.[POS Transaction ID] = PSL.[POS Transaction ID]
                   WHERE PTL.EmployeeName = SS.EmployeeName 
                       AND CONVERT(DATE, PTL.[Shift Date]) BETWEEN @FechaDesde AND @FechaHasta
                       AND PTL.[Shift No_] = SS.[Shift No_]
                       AND PSL.[POS Sales No_] = 'GAS00001'
                       AND (@Turno IS NULL OR @Turno = 0 OR PTL.[Shift No_] = @Turno)
                   FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 3, '')), '') AS KEROSENE_Precio

    FROM SalesSummary SS
    GROUP BY SS.EmployeeName, SS.[Shift No_], SS.FechaTurno;
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetSalesSummaryCL] 
    @FechaDesde DATE,
    @FechaHasta DATE,
    @Turno INT = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON; 

    -- Crear una tabla temporal para almacenar los resultados
    CREATE TABLE #SalesSummary (
        EmployeeName NVARCHAR(255),
        Shift NVARCHAR(50),
        Description NVARCHAR(255),
        TotalAmount DECIMAL(18,2)
    );

    -- Insertar datos en la tabla temporal
    INSERT INTO #SalesSummary (EmployeeName, Shift, Description, TotalAmount)
    SELECT 
        PTL.[EmployeeName],
        PTL.[Shift No_] AS [Shift],  
        PSCL.[Description],  
        CAST(SUM(PSCL.[Amount]) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS TotalAmount
    FROM [TPV].[dbo].[POS Transaction Log] PTL
    INNER JOIN [TPV].[dbo].[POS Sales Charge Line] PSCL 
        ON PTL.[POS Transaction ID] = PSCL.[POS Transaction ID]
    WHERE 
        CONVERT(DATE, PTL.[Shift Date]) BETWEEN @FechaDesde AND @FechaHasta
        AND (@Turno IS NULL OR @Turno = 0 OR PTL.[Shift No_] = @Turno)
    GROUP BY PTL.[EmployeeName], PTL.[Shift No_], PSCL.[Description];

    -- Usar PIVOT para convertir las filas de descripción en columnas fijas
    SELECT 
        EmployeeName, 
        Shift,
        ISNULL([Efectivo], 0) AS Efectivo,
        ISNULL([CREDITO], 0) AS CREDITO,
        ISNULL([POS Occidente], 0) AS [TC Occidente],
        ISNULL([POS BAC], 0) AS [POS BAC],
        ISNULL([Calibracion], 0) AS Calibracion,
        ISNULL([LEAL], 0) AS LEAL,

        -- Suma total incluyendo la nueva columna LEAL
        ISNULL([Efectivo], 0) + 
        ISNULL([CREDITO], 0) + 
        ISNULL([POS Occidente], 0) + 
        ISNULL([POS BAC], 0) + 
        ISNULL([Calibracion], 0) + 
        ISNULL([LEAL], 0) AS Total_Suma

    FROM 
        (SELECT EmployeeName, Shift, Description, TotalAmount FROM #SalesSummary) AS SourceTable
    PIVOT 
        (SUM(TotalAmount) FOR Description IN (
            [Efectivo], 
            [CREDITO], 
            [POS Occidente], 
            [POS BAC], 
            [Calibracion],
            [LEAL]
        )) AS PivotTable;

    -- Eliminar la tabla temporal
    DROP TABLE #SalesSummary;
END;

@parmIdTran  as varchar(20)  
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @Tipo smallint

            SELECT A.[Transaction Type],A.[POS Transaction ID] 
            FROM   [POS Transaction Log] as A

			(select [POS Transaction ID]  FROM [POS Sales Line] where not([Pump Position No_] = '' or ([Pump Position No_] <> '' and [Pump No_] <> '')))

  BEGIN
     SELECT @XML = CASE @Tipo
         when 0 THEN [dbo].[uf_Genera_VENTA_XML](@IdTran) 
         when 2 THEN [dbo].[uf_Genera_TANK_XML](@IdTran) 
         when 3 THEN [dbo].[uf_Genera_PUMP_XML](@IdTran)

     END 
     FETCH NEXT FROM   vt_cursor INTO      @Tipo,@idTran 
  END

END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_FinTurno] 
@FechaTurno date
,@Turno as varchar(1) 

AS
BEGIN


-- Distinto de DZR
Select [Item Category Code],sum(Quantity),sum([Amount Including VAT]) from (
SELECT  I.[Item Category Code]
	   ,L.[POS Sales No_] 
	   ,I.Description
	   ,sum([Quantity] ) as Quantity
       ,sum([Amount Including VAT]) as [Amount Including VAT] 
       FROM [POS Transaction Log] as T
	   left join [POS Sales Line] as L
	   ON  T.[POS Transaction ID]=L.[POS Transaction ID]
	   left join Item	 as I
	   ON  I.No_=L.[POS Sales No_] 
	   where T.[Shift Date] =@FechaTurno  and T.[Shift No_]=@Turno	
	   and T.[Transaction Type]=0
       and L.[POS Sales No_]<>'DZR'
group by I.[Item Category Code],I.Description, L.[POS Sales No_]
--order by I.[Item Category Code],I.Description, L.[POS Sales No_]

UNION  ALL

 -- DZR
 SELECT I.[Item Category Code]
	   ,L2.[POS Sales No_] 
	   ,I.Description
	  , 0 as Quantity
	  ,sum(L1.[Amount Including VAT]) as [Amount Including VAT] 
       FROM [POS Transaction Log] as T
  LEFT JOIN  [POS Sales Line] as L1
  ON  T.[POS Transaction ID]=L1.[POS Transaction ID]
  left JOIN  [POS Sales Line] as L2
 ON L2.[POS Transaction ID]=L1.[POS Transaction ID]
 AND L2.[POS Sales Doc_ No_]=L1.[POS Sales Doc_ No_]
  AND L2.[POS Sales Doc_ Line No_]=L1.[Applies-to Line No_]
  left join Item	 as I
ON  I.No_=L2.[POS Sales No_] 

  where  L1.[POS Sales No_]='DZR'
  AND  T.[Shift Date] =@FechaTurno and T.[Shift No_]=@Turno
group by I.[Item Category Code],I.Description, L2.[POS Sales No_]

) as a
group by [Item Category Code] 
order by [Item Category Code]





--Detalle de combustibles
-- Distinto de DZR
Select Description,sum(Quantity),sum([Amount Including VAT]) from (
SELECT  I.[Item Category Code]
	   ,L.[POS Sales No_] 
	   ,I.Description
	   ,sum([Quantity] ) as Quantity
       ,sum([Amount Including VAT]) as [Amount Including VAT] 
       FROM [POS Transaction Log] as T
	   left join [POS Sales Line] as L
	   ON  T.[POS Transaction ID]=L.[POS Transaction ID]
	   left join Item	 as I
	   ON  I.No_=L.[POS Sales No_] 
	   where T.[Shift Date] =@FechaTurno and T.[Shift No_]=@Turno	
	   and T.[Transaction Type]=0
       and L.[POS Sales No_]<>'DZR' 
       AND I.[Item Category Code]='PRODUCTO'

group by I.[Item Category Code],I.Description, L.[POS Sales No_]
--order by I.[Item Category Code],I.Description, L.[POS Sales No_]

UNION  ALL

 -- DZR
 SELECT I.[Item Category Code]
	    ,L2.[POS Sales No_] 
	   ,I.Description
	  , 0 as Quantity
	  ,sum(L1.[Amount Including VAT]) as [Amount Including VAT] 
       FROM [POS Transaction Log] as T
  LEFT JOIN  [POS Sales Line] as L1
  ON  T.[POS Transaction ID]=L1.[POS Transaction ID]
  left JOIN  [POS Sales Line] as L2
 ON L2.[POS Transaction ID]=L1.[POS Transaction ID]
 AND L2.[POS Sales Doc_ No_]=L1.[POS Sales Doc_ No_]
  AND L2.[POS Sales Doc_ Line No_]=L1.[Applies-to Line No_]
  left join Item	 as I
ON  I.No_=L2.[POS Sales No_] 

  where  L1.[POS Sales No_]='DZR' 
  AND I.[Item Category Code]='PRODUCTO'
  and T.[Transaction Type]=0
  AND  T.[Shift Date] =@FechaTurno and T.[Shift No_]=@Turno	
group by I.[Item Category Code],I.Description, L2.[POS Sales No_]

) as a
group by [Item Category Code],Description, [POS Sales No_]
order by [Item Category Code],Description, [POS Sales No_]







-- Cobros
 SELECT  C.[Charge Method Code] 
	   ,CM.Description
       ,sum(C.[Amount])
       FROM [POS Transaction Log] as T
	   left join [POS Sales Charge Line] as C
	   ON  T.[POS Transaction ID]=C.[POS Transaction ID]
	   left join [Charge Method] as CM
	   ON  C.[Charge Method Code] =CM.[Code]
	   where T.[Shift Date] =@FechaTurno and T.[Shift No_]=@Turno	
	   and T.[Transaction Type]=0 and CM.[Excl_ in Shift Summary]=0
	   group by C.[Charge Method Code],CM.Description
	   order by C.[Charge Method Code],CM.Description
 

END

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_Lista_Transacciones_XML] 
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @IdTran varchar(20)
DECLARE @XML XML
DECLARE @Tipo smallint
DECLARE vt_cursor CURSOR FOR
            SELECT A.[Transaction Type],A.[POS Transaction ID] 
            FROM   [POS Transaction Log] as A

OPEN vt_cursor 
FETCH NEXT FROM   vt_cursor INTO   @Tipo,@IdTran WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS <> - 1) 
  BEGIN
     SELECT @XML = CASE @Tipo
         when 0 THEN [dbo].[uf_Genera_VENTA_XML](@IdTran) 
         when 2 THEN [dbo].[uf_Genera_TANK_XML](@IdTran) 
         when 3 THEN [dbo].[uf_Genera_PUMP_XML](@IdTran) 
         when 4 THEN [dbo].[uf_Genera_CASH_XML](@IdTran) 
         when 5 THEN [dbo].[uf_Genera_CLOSE_XML](@IdTran) 
         when 6 THEN [dbo].[uf_Genera_EXT_RET_XML](@IdTran) 
     END 
SELECT @tipo, @XML

     FETCH NEXT FROM   vt_cursor INTO      @Tipo,@idTran 
  END 
CLOSE vt_cursor 
DEALLOCATE vt_cursor
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_ProximoCambioPrecio]  
	@FechaCambio dateTime =NULL   
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

SET @FechaCambio = ISNULL(@FechaCambio,GETDATE())

SELECT I.No_
	  ,I.Description	
	  ,cast(cast([Starting Date] as date) as datetime) + cast(cast([Starting Time] as time) as datetime) as FechaCambio
--	  ,A.[Starting Date]
 --     ,A.[Starting Time]
      ,A.[Unit Price]
 FROM(
 SELECT SP.[Item No_]
      ,SP.[Starting Date]
      ,SP.[Starting Time]
 	  ,SP.[Minimum Quantity]
      ,SP.[Unit Price]
	  ,ROW_NUMBER() 
  OVER (PARTITION BY   SP.[Item No_] 
  ORDER BY  
       SP.[Item No_] 
      ,SP.[Starting Date] desc
      ,SP.[Starting Time] desc
 	  ,SP.[Minimum Quantity]
      ,SP.[Unit Price]) as RK
	   FROM [Sales Price] AS SP
       WHERE ((cast([Starting Date] as date) = cast(@FechaCambio as date))  AND (CAST([Starting Time] as time) >= CAST(@FechaCambio as time)))
         OR (cast([Starting Date] as date) > cast(@FechaCambio as date) )
  ) as A

JOIN Item as I 
ON  A.[Item No_]= I.No_ 

  WHERE A.RK = 1 
  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_XMLVariableToFile]
   @TheXML XML,
   @Filename VARCHAR(255)
 AS
   SET NOCOUNT ON
   DECLARE @MySpecialTempTable VARCHAR(255)
   DECLARE @Command NVARCHAR(4000)
   DECLARE @RESULT INT
 
 --crea una tabla global temporal con nombre unico
   SELECT  @MySpecialTempTable = '##temp'
        + CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), CONVERT(INT, RAND() * 1000000))
 --Se crea con un SQL dinamico y se  inserta una fila
 --con la variable que contiene el XML
   SELECT  @Command = 'create table ['+ @MySpecialTempTable+ '] (MyID int identity(1,1), Bulkcol XML)
          insert into ['+ @MySpecialTempTable+ '](BulkCol) select @TheXML'
   EXECUTE sp_ExecuteSQL @command, N'@TheXML XML',@TheXML
 
 --then we execute the BCP to save the file
   SELECT  @Command = 'bcp "select BulkCol from ['
           + @MySpecialTempTable + ']'
           + '" queryout  "'
           + @Filename + '" '
          + '-w'--save as unicode
           + ' -T -S' + @@servername

   EXECUTE @RESULT= MASTER..xp_cmdshell @command, NO_OUTPUT
   EXECUTE ( 'Drop table ' + @MySpecialTempTable )
   RETURN @result

CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_POS_Sales_With_Turnos
AS
SELECT 
    /* 1. Enumeración de turnos (Global por fecha e ID, sin separar por POS) */ 
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY 
            CAST(TL.[Shift Date] AS DATE) ASC, 
            CS.[POS Transaction ID] ASC
    ) AS [numero_turno], 

    /* 2. Información de la línea de venta y función personalizada */ 
    SL.*, 
    dbo.ConvertirPosicionBomba(SL.[Pump Position No_]) AS [manguera_numero], 

    /* 3. Información del Log de Transacción */ 
    CAST(TL.[Shift Date] AS DATE) AS [fecha_turno], 
    TL.[Shift No_] AS [Log_Shift_No], 
    TL.[EmployeeName] AS [Log_Employee], 

    /* 4. Información de Conciliación (Turno Cerrado) */ 
    CS.[POS Transaction ID] AS [turno_conciliador], 
    CS.[Shift Starting] AS [hora_inicio], 
    CS.[Shift Ending] AS [hora_fin], 
    CS.[ImporteContado], 

    /* 5. Datos Fusion (si no existe → 0) */ 
    ISNULL(FS.[Amount], 0) AS [FSAmount], 
    ISNULL(FS.[PPU], 0) AS [FSPPU], 
    ISNULL(FS.[Volume], 0) AS [FSVolume], 
    ISNULL(FS.[FinalVolumeTotal], 0) AS [FSFinalVolumeTotal], 
    ISNULL(FS.[InitialVolumeTotal], 0) AS [FSInitialVolumeTotal], 
    ISNULL(FS.[ShiftID], 0) AS [FSShiftID]

FROM [TPV].[dbo].[POS Sales Line] AS SL 

/* JOIN con Log: Se quitó SL.[POS Code] = TL.[POS Code] */
INNER JOIN [TPV].[dbo].[POS Transaction Log] AS TL 
    ON SL.[POS Transaction ID] = TL.[POS Transaction ID] 
    AND SL.[Gas Station Code] = TL.[Gas Station Code]

/* JOIN con Conciliación: Se quitó TL.[POS Code] = CS.[POS Code] */
LEFT JOIN [TPV].[dbo].[POS Closed Shift] AS CS 
    ON TL.[Gas Station Code] = CS.[Gas Station Code] 
    AND TL.[Shift No_] = CS.[Shift] 
    AND TL.[EmployeeName] = CS.[EmployeeName] 
    AND CAST(TL.[Shift Date] AS DATE) = CAST(CS.[Shift Starting] AS DATE) 

LEFT JOIN [FusionController].[dbo].[FusionSales] AS FS 
    ON FS.[SaleID] = SL.[SaleID];

    ptl.[Shift Date],
